1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Suns led 28–22 after one quarter. At the half, the Suns led 55–50.

Scroll to keep going
2 of 5 · The difference

Booker: 30 points, 7 assists, 3 steals

12 of 20 from the floor, 13 in the first quarter.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the fourth quarter 29–20

Down 4 after three quarters, the Suns won the fourth quarter 29–20 to win 101–96. Booker and Brooks combined for 45 of 101.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it on defense: 25 Hornets turnovers to 7

Turnovers forced 25–7; steals 11–4. Charlotte had 52 rebounds to 31.

5 of 5 · Final

Suns 101, Hornets 96.

From the Hornets’ side: Led by 4 after three quarters, then lost the fourth 20–29.

What it meant: Suns 5–6, 11th in the West, 3% top-6 odds. Hornets 4–8, 10th in the East, 10%.

2 · The play of the game

Booker from 28 feet.

Devin Booker's 28-foot step-back 3-pointer in the final 30 seconds that turned 94-91 into 97-91.
